title: Domain Care Deposit-Volume Credit on Restore Charges, Domain Registrations
content:
## Questions answered: the deposit-volume credit on a restore charge

**What is it?** The restore line's volume credit is one of the Domain Care credits a restore charge of a Domain Registrations domain earns.

**What is the rule?** The restore line's volume credit is USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's account less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match total USD 5000.00 or more, USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered where they total at least USD 250.00 but less than USD 5000.00, and nothing where they total less, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

**Which records are read?** The deposits into account credit on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account. The look-back runs from the day of the price match, not from the date the restore charge was billed.

**When does a deposit drop out of the window?** Once 12 whole months have passed. A deposit posted on 24 July 2028 still counts on 23 July 2029 (11 whole months) and no longer counts on 24 July 2029 (12 whole months).

**What are the bands?**

| Deposits in the window | Credit for each year the charge covered |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 or more | USD 0.50 |
| From USD 250.00 to less than USD 5000.00 | USD 0.25 |
| Less than USD 250.00 | Nothing |

*Hypothetical example:* window deposits totalling USD 5000.00 on a restore charge that covered one year earn USD 0.50; totalling USD 4999.99, USD 0.25; totalling USD 249.99, nothing.
